title: Post-market review: Fri Nov 27
headline: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear elevated as of Nov 26 (latest reading not stored yet).

verdict.text: 1 setup triggered today; none is eligible to act on. QQQ rose 2.7% on its last session but is still 7.8% below its 50-day average: price has bounced, the trend is not repaired.
